title: A quasidiagonal $C^*$-algebra with a nonquasidiagonal maximal tensor square
summary: We construct a separable unital residually finite-dimensional $C^*$-algebra $A$ whose maximal tensor square contains a proper isometry. In particular, $A$ is quasidiagonal whereas $A\tmax A$ is not. The algebra is generated by finite regular representations obtained from congruence quotients of an explicit countable affine group. A property~$(T)$ subgroup determines a diagonal Kazhdan projection in the maximal tensor square. Conjugation by a dilation makes this projection equivalent to a proper subprojection.
